title: Effect of a Traveller Club Membership or a Corporate Programme on a Car Rental
content:
Holding an active traveller club membership changes what this rental is charged: the club tier held on the
collection date decides the discount applied to the rental rate and whether a vehicle class upgrade is
offered, and the rate class's own terms decide everything else. Across the Car Rental Rate Classes the
discount basis is the club tier held on the collection date, and no other date.

## Club and corporate are mutually exclusive

A club discount and a corporate programme rate are mutually exclusive on one rental: where the rental
carries a corporate programme reference the negotiated rate stands alone and no club discount is applied on
top of it.

A rate class that is not eligible for a corporate rate may still be booked under a programme, but at its
public price.

## The upgrade

A club upgrade is offered only on a rate class that permits it and only where the supplier has the higher
class available; it is never converted into money or into a discount. Both conditions must hold together.

| Rate class permits an upgrade | Supplier has the higher class available | Upgrade offered |
| --- | --- | --- |
| no | no | no |
| no | yes | no |
| yes | no | no |
| yes | yes | yes |

## Points

Club points accrue on the rental total actually paid, at the earn rate of the rate class booked, and never
on taxes, statutory fees, the deposit hold or the agency service fee.

A corporate negotiated rate class earns no club points at all, whatever the renter's personal tier.
